title: Set 219

sentences.ko: 넌 맨날 아무거나 괜찮다고 하면서, 막상 내가 뭘 틀면 그 표정 짓잖아. 그러니까 이번엔 그냥 네가 고르는 게 어때?
sentences.text: You always say you're fine with anything, but then I put something on and you make that face, so why don't you just pick this time?

alts.text: Come on, you always say anything's fine, then I put something on and you make that face. So you pick this time, okay?
You always tell me that you are happy with anything, yet when I put something on, you make that face. Would you mind choosing this time?

sentences.note: **put something on** 은 영상이나 음악을 튼다는 뜻이에요. **make that face** 는 마음에 안 드는 티를 얼굴로 낸다는 말이고, **why don't you** 는 ~하는 게 어때? 하고 권할 때 써요.

sentences.ko: 아니 뭐, 돈은 잘 줘. 솔직히 아직 거기 다니는 이유는 돈 하나뿐이야. 근데 일요일 밤만 되면 속이 꽉 막힌 것처럼 답답한데, 그렇게 되는 게 정상은 아닌 것 같아.
sentences.text: I mean, the pay's good, and honestly that's the only reason I'm still there. But I get this knot in my stomach every Sunday night, and I don't think that's normal.

alts.text: Look, the money's good, and that's honestly the only reason I'm still there. But every Sunday night my stomach's in a knot, and I don't think that's normal.
To be honest, the salary is good, and that is the only reason I remain there. However, I feel a knot in my stomach every Sunday evening, and I do not believe that is normal.

sentences.note: **knot in my stomach** 는 긴장하거나 불안해서 속이 꼬이고 답답한 느낌을 말해요. **the pay's good** 은 월급이 괜찮다는 말이고, 캐주얼하게는 **the money's good** 이라고도 해요.

sentences.ko: 토요일에 할머니 뵈러 차 타고 올라갔는데, 어쩌다 보니 할머니한테 넘어가서 거실 가구 배치를 통째로 바꾸는 걸 도와드렸거든. 그래서 허리가 너무 아파. 근데 할머니가 너무 좋아하셔서 뭐라 할 수가 없어.
sentences.text: We drove up to see my grandma on Saturday, and she somehow talked me into helping her rearrange her whole living room, so my back is killing me. But she was so happy about it that I can't really complain.

alts.text: Saturday we drove up to my grandma's, and somehow she got me moving all her living room furniture around, so my back's killing me. But she was so happy I can't really complain.

On Saturday we drove up to visit my grandmother, and she somehow persuaded me to help her rearrange her entire living room, so my back is quite sore. However, she was so pleased that I cannot really complain.

sentences.note: **talked me into** 는 말로 구슬려서 나를 ~하게 만들었다는 뜻이에요. **my back is killing me** 는 허리가 아파 죽겠다는 말로, 아픈 데를 말할 때 자주 써요.

sentences.ko: 잠깐, 너 목요일은 돼야 올 수 있으면 그냥 일정을 통째로 하루 미룰까? 네가 절반을 놓치는 것보다 처음에 하루 날리는 게 나을 것 같아서.
sentences.text: Wait, if you can't get there till Thursday, should we just push the whole thing back a day? Because I'd rather lose a day at the start than have you miss half of it.

alts.text: Hang on, you can't make it till Thursday? Then should we just push it all back a day? I'd rather lose a day up front than have you miss half.
If you are unable to arrive until Thursday, should we postpone the entire plan by one day? I would prefer to lose a day at the beginning rather than have you miss half of it.

sentences.note: **push the whole thing back** 은 일정을 통째로 뒤로 미룬다는 뜻이에요. **I'd rather A than B** 는 B보다는 A가 낫다고 할 때 쓰는 표현이에요.

sentences.ko: 아, 나도 그러고 싶은데, 지난번에 차를 빌려줬더니 찌그러져서 돌아왔는데 어쩌다 그렇게 됐는지 아무도 모르더라고. 그래서 이제 차는 안 빌려주기로 나름 정했어. 너라서 그러는 거 아니야, 진짜로.
sentences.text: Ugh, I wish I could, but the last time I lent my car out, it came back with a dent and nobody knew how it got there, so I kind of made a rule not to lend it out anymore. It's not you, I promise.

alts.text: Man, I wish I could, but last time I lent my car out it came back with a dent and nobody knew how, so I kinda made a rule. No lending it out anymore. It's not you, promise.

I really wish I could, but the last time I lent my car to someone, it was returned with a dent and no one knew how it had happened, so I have made it a rule not to lend it out anymore. I assure you it is nothing personal.

sentences.note: **lend it out** 은 남에게 물건을 빌려준다는 뜻이에요. **It's not you** 는 너 때문이 아니라고 상대를 안심시킬 때 쓰고, **I wish I could** 는 그러고 싶지만 못 한다고 부드럽게 거절할 때 써요.

reviewed: 2번 note 의 a knot in my stomach 는 본문(this knot in my stomach)에 그대로 나오지 않아 knot in my stomach 로 고침
3번 casual 의 redoing 은 리모델링한다는 뜻으로 들려서, 가구 배치를 옮긴다는 원래 뜻에 맞게 moving all her living room furniture around 로 고침
4번 한국어 목요일까지 못 오면 은 목요일 전에 못 온다는 뜻으로 읽혀서, can't get there till Thursday(목요일에야 도착한다)에 맞게 목요일은 돼야 올 수 있으면 으로 고침
4번 note 의 push back 은 본문에 붙어서 나오지 않아 본문 그대로인 push the whole thing back 으로 고침
5번 note 의 lend out 은 본문에 붙어서 나오지 않아 본문 그대로인 lend it out 으로 고침
